subject.title: fix(heartbeat): skip scheduled heartbeat on idle sessions

question: Should OpenClaw accept a fixed seven-day scheduled-heartbeat idle safety gate after the preflight-ordering bug is repaired, or require the configurable activity-timeout design first?
rationale: The source bug and a narrow repair are clear, but a fixed default changes existing scheduled heartbeat semantics and overlaps the open heartbeat idle-timeout product tracker.

options.title: Accept Repaired Safety Guard
options.body: After preserving due commitments and queued event work, merge the fixed seven-day scheduled-heartbeat guard as an immediate spend-safety baseline.

options.title: Wait For Configurable Policy
options.body: Keep this PR blocked and solve idle behavior through the activity-timeout tracker with schema, docs, upgrade behavior, and tests.

options.title: Require Opt-In Only
options.body: Ask for an explicit setting or warning path instead of changing default scheduled heartbeat behavior for existing users.

recommendation.title: Accept Repaired Safety Guard
recommendation.body: After preserving due commitments and queued event work, merge the fixed seven-day scheduled-heartbeat guard as an immediate spend-safety baseline.
